title: CRISPR screen reveals SOX2 as a critical regulator of CD133 and cellular stress response in glioblastoma
model: BT935 patient-derived glioblastoma cells, TKOv3 genome-wide knockout, FACS for CD133
contrast: CD133 top 5% vs bottom 5% sort, paired by replicate (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: SOX2 as the key regulator of PROM1 (CD133)
barcs_calls: 0 genes at FDR 0.10 after control calibration (131 before)
named_hits: PROM1 rank 1, SOX2 rank 10; neither significant after calibration
verdict: BARCS ranks PROM1, the gene encoding CD133, first and SOX2 tenth, in line with the paper, but after calibrating to the non-targeting guides (15% reached p < 0.05 before) no gene passes FDR 0.10. The ranking supports SOX2; the screen alone does not establish it at genome-wide significance.
